ideas.pitch: An automated ML framework designed to survive progressive dataset unlocking, missing feature injection, and adversarial data sabotage in competitive data science.
ideas.problem_statement: ModelWars is a multi-stage Machine Learning competition featuring dataset challenges, token-based decisions, and adversarial sabotage.
ideas.title: RobustGuard ML Pipeline
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the specific Model Kombat round requirements by implementing automated imputers and adversarial outlier rejection directly aligned with the competition rules.

ideas.pitch: A reinforcement learning helper that optimizes token expenditure and private score checks across progressive dataset unlocking rounds.
ideas.problem_statement: Teams begin with 30% of the dataset and unlock additional portions (45%, 70%, 100%) using tokens for leaderboard submissions and private score checks.
ideas.title: TokenOptima: ML Strategy Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the economic constraint of the Dataset Games by mathematically optimizing token usage versus information gain.

ideas.pitch: An automated model explanation and defense dashboard using SHAP values to prepare teams for the Explainfinity War live judging round.
ideas.problem_statement: Explainfinity War involves in-person explanation and defense of modeling approaches and decisions against adversarial interrogation.
ideas.title: Explainfinity Shield
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides judges with instant, crystal-clear interpretability charts, directly satisfying the defense criteria of the final round.

ideas.pitch: A diagnostic data-auditing tool that detects and isolates adversarial data injection and feature corruption introduced during Model Kombat.
ideas.problem_statement: Model Kombat involves adversarial dataset sabotage where competing teams inject noise or corrupt data.
ideas.title: SabotageSleuth
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the exact destructive mechanism of Round 2 by isolating poisoned data rows before they crash model metrics.

ideas.pitch: A dynamic fallback model architecture that automatically reroutes inference flows when essential features are missing or locked out.
ideas.problem_statement: Teams build a machine learning model that can withstand corrupted data and adapt to missing essential features.
ideas.title: AdaptivePipeline Ensemble
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates robust software engineering alongside data science, keeping performance high even when feature availability drops.
